say:3:1611349001:1.text: Magister Merlin, it's been ages! Are you here to see who's gonna be the next headmaster too?
say:3:1611349001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，好久不见！您也来看谁会是下一任新校长吗？

say:3:1611349001:1.female: Magister Merlin, it's been ages! Are you here to see who's gonna be the next headmaster too?

say:5:1611349002:1.text: Well, I think anyone would be better than Madam Durella!
say:5:1611349002:1.source_cn: 这样啊……不过我想无论谁成为新校长，都会比杜瑞拉女士更好。

say:6:1611349003:1.text: I seriously can't believe the acting headmistress worked with outsiders to hurt students. If she hadn't been caught, the Lyceum would've been totally messed up.
say:6:1611349003:1.source_cn: 我完全没想到，代理校长居然和外人勾结来伤害学校里的学生...

say:7:1611349004:1.text: So, who do you think will be the next headmaster?
say:7:1611349004:1.source_cn: 你们觉得新校长会是谁？

say:8:1611349005:1.text: Umm... maybe Professor Fernando? Or Professor Viktor? What do you think?
say:8:1611349005:1.source_cn: 我认为，或许是费尔南多老师或者维克托老师，你们呢？

say:9:1611349006:1.text: I don't know... Neither of them really has experience running a school, right? Shouldn't it be someone who does?
say:9:1611349006:1.source_cn: 不知道……我还没想好。而且，他们都没做过行政工作啊！得...

say:10:1611349007:1.text: I think it should be Professor Zorya! I mean, she's the oldest teacher here now. And I heard she even taught you once, Magister Merlin!
say:10:1611349007:1.source_cn: 我认为应该是佐尔娅老师。理由很简单，她是目前莱希拉姆最...

say:10:1611349007:1.female: I think it should be Professor Zorya! I mean, she's the oldest teacher here now. And I heard she even taught you once, Magister Merlin!

say:11:1611349008:1.source_cn: 什么？梅林大人，她曾经教过您？

choice_prompt:12:1611349008.source_cn: 什么？梅林大人，她曾经教过您？

say:13:1611349009:1.text: Then... yeah. I think it should be Professor Zorya too.
say:13:1611349009:1.source_cn: 那我……我也觉得应该是佐尔娅老师。

say:14:1611349010:1.text: Hey, weren't you just saying you couldn't decide?
say:14:1611349010:1.source_cn: 喂，雷蒙德，你刚才不是还没想好吗？

say:15:1611349011:1.text: You two, stop arguing already! Don't bicker in front of Magister Merlin. That's rude!
say:15:1611349011:1.source_cn: 你们两个，在梅林大人面前别这样打打闹闹的，太没礼貌了。
